Source: https://game-icons.net/ (downloaded 2026-10-09, white on transparent, unmodified).

- `boots.svg` - "Boots" by Lorc, https://game-icons.net/1x1/lorc/boots.html
- `pearl-necklace.svg` - "Pearl necklace" by Delapouite,
  https://game-icons.net/1x1/delapouite/pearl-necklace.html
- `person.svg` - "Person" by Delapouite, https://game-icons.net/1x1/delapouite/person.html

Used in the equipment window: footwear and neck items, and the body silhouette
(cropped and tinted at run time; the files are unchanged).
